content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

- **§ 12.4 (p0046)** imposes on us a non-compete running for the term plus **24 months**, covering **any** competing product or service in **any** territory, and expressly barring **acquisitions**. This fails the fallback on every material term (post-term length >12 months, undefined scope, no internal-development/acquisition carve-out) and lands in walk-away territory.
- It also flatly contradicts **§ 12.3 (p0044)**, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment and that nothing restricts our business in any field or territory.
- Redline validated (`ok:true`): delete § 12.4 entirely, reaching the preferred position and resolving the internal inconsistency, with the narrowed fallback (named product, term only, 12 months, carve-outs) offered in the comment as a fallback if Vendor needs protection.
